files.rationale: Need to add a navigation bar component to provide consistent navigation across the application
Need to add a footer component to provide consistent footer content across the application
Need to update the main App component to include the new navigation bar and footer components in the layout

summary: Adding a navigation bar and footer to the TaskFlow application to improve user experience and provide consistent layout across all pages. The NavBar component will contain links to the main application sections, and the Footer component will provide consistent footer content. The App.jsx file will be modified to include these new components in the overall application layout.
